#
# Regenerate with (from the repo root, uv installed):
#
#    uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.9 --generate-hashes --no-header \
#      -o .github/tools/requirements-ci.txt .github/tools/requirements-ci.in
#
# --universal with --python-version 3.9 matters: CI's test matrix runs Python 3.9 AND
# 3.12, and a lock resolved on 3.12 alone pinned iniconfig==2.3.0 (Requires-Python
# >=3.10) and omitted pytest's 3.9-only deps (exceptiongroup, tomli), so the 3.9 leg
# could not install at all. The environment markers below select the right pin per
# interpreter; every line is still hash-pinned for --require-hashes.
#
# Every hash below was cross-checked against the sha256 digests PyPI's JSON API
# reports for the corresponding file (GET /pypi/<name>/<version>/json, `.urls[].digests.sha256`) —
# not just accepted from a local resolver run.
#
iniconfig==2.3.0 \
    --hash=sha256:c76315c77db068650d49c5b56314774a7804df16fee4402c1f19d6d15d8c4730 \
    --hash=sha256:f631c04d2c48c52b84d0d0549c99ff3859c98df65b3101406327ecc7d53fbf12
    # via pytest

    --hash=sha256:94edc256424af38762eb31306eed28beb9f0efc50a8837492c9d6fd6004aed79 \
    --hash=sha256:d7193f7c8e4e93f444fde0262bf90af30e16fa0ad0ad44cb553c87339b23cd1c
    # via pytest
